name: cs-paper-team
description: A multi-agent team that reads computer-science papers collaboratively: a lead editor plus four specialists covering method/mechanism, experiment evidence, reproducibility, and literature positioning, producing a credibility-graded structured report.

displayDescription.en: A lead editor plus four specialists collaboratively read CS papers across method, experiment evidence, reproducibility and literature positioning, and grade the conclusion's credibility.
displayDescription.zh: 由主理人与四位专家分工，从方法机理、实验证据、系统复现、领域文献四维度精读 CS 论文并评估可信度

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我用专家团精读这篇 CS 论文（附 PDF / 链接 / arXiv ID），四人分工出完整解读与可信度评估
defaultInitPrompt.en: Use the team to read this CS paper closely for me (PDF / link / arXiv ID); split the work across four specialists and give a full reading with a credibility grade

quickPrompts.en: Use the team to read this CS paper closely for me (PDF / link / arXiv ID); split the work across four specialists and give a full reading with a credibility grade
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我用专家团精读这篇 CS 论文（附 PDF / 链接 / arXiv ID），四人分工出完整解读与可信度评估

quickPrompts.en: Is the method actually novel and do the experiments really support the claims? Dissect it from the method and evidence angles.
quickPrompts.zh: 这篇论文的方法到底新在哪？实验是否真支撑结论？从方法和证据两路帮我拆解

quickPrompts.en: Can this be reproduced, and which prior works is it really related to? Give me a replication path and literature positioning.
quickPrompts.zh: 这篇能复现吗？它和哪几篇工作真正相关？给我复现路径和文献定位
